verdict.rationale: LM Studio documents on-demand loading: an inference request to a model that isn't loaded loads it before the request returns. Its CLI loads models under custom identifiers with `lms load`, separately from `lms server start/stop`. Together these suggest models can be loaded and switched while the server keeps running. The docs never state explicitly that several models stay loaded at once or that switching needs no server restart, and documented unload/eject is only mentioned in passing in a community comment. missing for 10: explicit documentation of multiple simultaneously loaded models, explicit no-restart model swapping, documented unload/TTL management, independent hands-on corroboration of switching under a running server

support.subject: As a power-user, I can load and switch between multiple models without restarting the server

citations.quote: to use a model, simply send an inferencing request to it. If the model is not yet loaded, it'll be loaded before your request returns.
no easy way to unload it like the eject button in LM Studio
